entry.title: Beijing South railway station

groundCutout.basis: Only closed north/south entrance-floor crescents beyond the actual mapped platform/track corridor. The layer2 oval roof,upper concourse,raised approach decks,all13platforms,stairs,tracks,streets and forecourts receive no blanket ground opening.

buildingCutout.basis: Whole individual Beijing South passenger station: complete mapped oval roof and both curved entrance fronts,rolled eaves/soffit and roof bands,raised transverse concourse,attached curved approach deck sections and supports,all thirteen whole native platforms and their connecting stairs. Preserve independent buildings,streets,rail lines and water. No blanket oval floor or terrain opening. Current named Beijing South POIs and one whole oval layer2 footprint35184415134069 associate Q163962 with this physical terminal;no exact-Q-tagged building is claimed. The thirteen full station platform polygons and railway alignment resolve signed NE/SW track and SE/NW entrance axes. Ordinary whole-roof aerial and southern-front photograph supply broad banded curved roof,rolled metal eave/deep soffit,two-level curved glazing and white approach deck/columns. Source floor+.9m and upper concourse/attached approach decks14m,wall27.3m,roof edge28m/crest42m are explicit picture/map-scale estimates,not native height facts. Use one unchanged global viewer datum at outside forecourt[25,250],45.720697m absolute. Actual grade,rail clearances,hidden elevations,internal concourse extent,roof-band controls and intermediate facade details remain unverified. Closed ground floors are only the two front/rear crescents beyond the mapped track/platform corridor;the layer2 oval roof is not a blanket ground floor. An elevated transverse concourse and13separate platform stairs provide visible physical connectivity. No copied lettering,emblems,brands,signs,trains,people,private images or navigable passenger interiors.
